_meta.title: Backroom — temporary cruising-area research tracker
_meta.status: Research only — do not publish findings directly

definitions.cruising_now: Count of existing listings in listings.json where Category is exactly 'Cruising Area' and Status is exactly 'Live'.
definitions.proposals: Number of unique new cruising areas found in research that are not already in Backroom; count once per country/city even when multiple websites mention the location.
definitions.scrape_n: One numbered source website per scrape. Registry below records the website URL. Each city.scrapes.scrape_n is an array of findings from that website; retain its specific source page URL.
definitions.proposed_places: Deduplicated new candidates, with stable proposal_id, name, location details, evidence and linked scrape IDs; only these count toward proposals.
definitions.existing_cruising: All baseline Category='Cruising Area' listing names, IDs, and statuses, including inactive records to prevent re-adding them.
definitions.city_names: Use one canonical city when clearly equivalent (Frankfurt/Frankfurt am Main, St Julian's spelling). Preserve other city strings if ambiguous; add new cities as needed.

_meta.continuation: In future chats, load this GitHub file first, then each submitted research website. Add a new record to sources as scrape_1, scrape_2, etc, add per-city findings to city.scrapes[scrape_id], add unique candidates to proposed_places, recalculate city/country proposals, and commit the updated file. Never modify listings.json until final cross-reference and explicit publication step. All scrape_1 source findings are candidate-level, not 2026-verified or publish-ready. Preserve raw names/types; do not dedupe different cities. Cities may be added even if Backroom had no venues there.
_meta.exclusions: 33 baseline entries without a country and one Europe-wide multi-city listing are not assigned to a country. Czech Republic is merged under Czechia. This is a country/city research tracker, not a complete copy of listings.json.
review_notes: Serbia source page has two Kosovo-labelled entries; stored in Kosovo country for review, not treated as verified country assignment.
Scrape 1 processed each of 45 Backroom countries where the source country pages were available; no qualifying claim of activity recency is made from merely appearing in this directory.

Country page top lists include public toilets, transport sites, stores, gyms, restaurants, saunas and other public venues; publication requires extra review for legality, consent, and appropriateness.
Source labels are not necessarily canonical Backroom city labels (for example source 'Praha' was recorded as Prague).
Failed countries Albania, Croatia, Moldova are not recorded as zero results; Kosovo lacks an independently listed page.

Scrape 1 results are raw counts of directory top listings; proposed_places and proposals are preliminary candidates based on exact city/name match only and NOT final deduplicated, verified new places.

countries_failed.reason: Country page could not be accessed (HTTP 451).
Country page could not be accessed (HTTP 451).

No separate Kosovo page was found in source country directory. Two Kosovo-labelled places were present under Serbia and are tracked in Kosovo for later verification.

city_specific_extension_notes: Supplemented national top-15 results with targeted city pages for Maspalomas, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Mykonos.
Maspalomas Dunes and Camel Station are marked probable matches to Backroom Maspalomas Dunes; Mykonos Paraportiani is marked probable match to Paraportiani Church rocks.
Source places Achivadolimni beach (Milos island) under Mykonos. Preserve raw source entry but verify its true geographic location and do not publish as Mykonos without checking.
2026 comments appeared on Maspalomas and Las Palmas pages; specific claims should be independently checked for currency and site access restrictions.
